prompt: What should the staff do if the product model stays the same?
promptZh: 如果產品型號不變，員工應該怎麼做？

options.text: Continue on the old results page.
options.whyZh: 更換支撐件後，型號不變也必須開新頁。

options.text: Keep testing with the old support.
options.whyZh: 是否更換和產品型號是否變更無關。

options.text: Open a separate results page after the change.
options.zh: 更換後開一頁新的結果頁。
options.whyZh: 產品型號不能用來決定是否共用結果頁；治具組態已變，須開新頁。

options.text: Skip the photograph of the earlier setup.
options.zh: 略過拍攝舊組態的照片。
options.whyZh: 原組態照片須在更換前拍攝，沒有型號例外。

explanationZh: 產品型號不能用來決定是否共用結果頁；治具組態已變，須開新頁。
evidence: Start a new results page after the switch, even for the same product model.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Start a new results page after the switch, even for the same product model.
